scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @review-bot/review-engine && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @review-bot/review-engine && npm run build --workspace @review-bot/api && npm run build --workspace @review-bot/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @review-bot/review-engine && npm run build --workspace @review-bot/review-engine && npm run test --workspace @review-bot/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @review-bot/review-engine && npm run build --workspace @review-bot/review-engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @review-bot/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @review-bot/web
